title: Zainab gale ko choom le
body:
Zainab gale ko choom le
Haaye..
Rukhsat ko aaye khaime mein jab shah e karbala to binte ali ne jodke haatho'n ko di sadaa
<<MINI>>
zainab gale ko choom le bhaiyya to jaiyye..(3)
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
zainab gale ko choom le bhaiyya to jaiyye
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Amma kahengi dekh ke chehra lahu bhara
Zainab ne kya khayal nahi rakhha bhai ka..(2)
haye, chadar se...
chadar se saaf karlu jo chehra to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zainab ghareeb hogayi kuch bhi nahi bacha
laashe uthake aun o mohammad ke mai zara..(2)
haye, ek baar...
ek baar phir utar lu sadqa to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaane na deti barchiyo walo'n mein mai kabhi
wo maa hai aur kaneez hu bhaiyya mai aapki
arey rann mein bula rahi hai jo Zahra to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Rokungi phir na aapko waada raha mera
nazdeek hai yaha'n se najaf shah e karbala..(2)
aajaye mere paas jo baba to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lagta hai rann mein aapka karta hai intezaar
lehra raha hai haath mein khanjar wo baar baar
bhaiyya, arey bhaiyya, arey bhaiyya
badal le shimr irada to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Karni hai jang aakhri bhaiyya behen nisaar
khoo'n beh raha hai kaise chalayenge zulfiqaar..(2)
baazu ka zakhm baandh de behna to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zindaa'n mein hum jo qabr e sakina banaenge
kya aap leke ghazi ko us waqt aaenge..(2)
arey, kar lijiye..
kar lijiye behen se ye wada to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kaise bayaa'n ho meer takallum wo bekasi
ye kehke bint e fatima khamosh hogayi
haye wade mein der hoti hai accha to jaiyye
<<MINI>>
so jaye thodi der sakina to jaiyye
